query.text: 请帮我留意厨房里的人和器具，有安全风险及时通知我。
query.text_en: Please help me keep an eye on the people and utensils in the kitchen, and notify me in time if there are any safety risks.

annotation.text_zh: 蒸汽很烫，手不要靠得太近，小心烫伤。
annotation.text_en: The steam is very hot, keep your hands away so you don't get burned.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
